title: The Partition Graph as a Growing Discrete Geometric Object
summary: For each positive integer $n$, let $G_n$ be the graph of integer partitions of $n$, where two partitions are adjacent if one is obtained from the other by an elementary transfer of a cell in the Ferrers diagram, followed by reordering. Previous work has studied the global homotopy type of the clique complex $Cl(G_n)$ and the local combinatorics of $G_n$ at a fixed vertex. This paper initiates the study of $G_n$ itself as a growing discrete geometric object.
